method: Static code and current-diff inspection only; no validator, test, model, Skill, backend or replay was run for this review. Root-owned files were not edited.

findings.issue: Partial receipt regeneration loses delivered fragment and stage target context.
findings.evidence: The context permits only annotation_view and partial; rebuilt prepare_review_material receives neither fragments nor stage_failures. _target_index adds fragment:* and stage:* targets only when those values are supplied.
findings.impact: A record targeting a delivered valid fragment alias can validate during isolation and become unknown when _build_core regenerates the ledger, rejecting a legitimate partial receipt.
findings.fix: Preserve and verify the necessary selected fragment/failure context, or use an exact canonicalization of aliases with evidence retained; test partial receipt creation and regeneration with a fragment-targeted valid/invalid record.

findings.issue: Malformed annotation_view can raise an uncaught TypeError.
findings.evidence: context[annotation_view] is tested for membership in a set before checking its type; list/dict JSON values are unhashable.
findings.fix: Require a string before set membership and reject malformed context with a strict ValueError/receipt diagnostic; include list and dict cases.

findings.issue: Per-record record_sha256 is not consistently the raw candidate record digest.
findings.evidence: Initial failure calls pass raw row, but duplicate and source-conflict calls pass parsed rows with default fields/derived owner. failure hashes that row; the successful path instead hashes the original candidate record.
findings.impact: The whole candidate and deterministic regeneration remain retained, so no acceptance bypass was established; however a duplicate/conflict record digest can fail to identify candidate[record_path].
findings.fix: Resolve and hash the raw record consistently; optionally record a separate normalized-record digest. Test omitted defaults and derived-owner duplicates/conflicts.

positive_checks: Expected contract inventory coverage is enumerated independently of candidate rows.
Unknown/invalid identities are not silently accepted; duplicate contract/projection identities invalidate all matching rows.
Known source-input aliases require exact request/response pair validation.
Local barriers expand exact paired requests/responses and block affected contract/projection availability.
reviewed_contract_scopes and reviewed_acquisition_projections consult blocked IDs; no direct availability bypass was found.
Partial receipt regeneration compares the exact candidate-derived review and ledger, and selected source/CFG/annotation/inventory bindings are checked.
limits: Findings refer to the recorded hashes, before root applies follow-up fixes. This is not dynamic malformed-input fuzzing or a full acceptance verdict.
